entities.name: Query FMN dehydrogenase
observations: 199 aa soluble flavoprotein-like sequence with predicted FMN_red domain at residues 3-142 and Flavodoxin_1 domain at residues 6-136.
Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q0A961, annotated as NAD(P)H dehydrogenase (quinone).
Reference enzyme binds one FMN per monomer and is assigned EC 1.6.5.2.
Sequence-based molecular mass is approximately 21.15 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.51.

entities.name: Q0A961
observations: Reviewed Alkalilimnicola ehrlichii protein with 100% identity and 100% coverage to the query sequence; exact sequence hash match.
Annotated as FMN-dependent NAD(P)H dehydrogenase (quinone), EC 1.6.5.2.
Catalyzes quinone + NAD(P)H + H+ to quinol + NAD(P)+; Rhea mappings RHEA:46160 and RHEA:46164.
Binds one FMN per monomer; UniProt evidence includes flavodoxin-like domain and quinone/NAD(P)H dehydrogenase functions.

entities.name: FMN
observations: The reference protein binds one FMN cofactor per monomer; ChEBI:CHEBI:58210.

entities.name: Quinone reduction by NAD(P)H
observations: Reference annotations support quinone + NADH + H+ = quinol + NAD+ and quinone + NADPH + H+ = quinol + NADP+; exact quinone substrate is not established from this sequence alone.
